label: Chum chum
note: Oval chhena sweet from Tangail, Bangladesh (Porabari variety, mid-19th century), garnished with coconut or mawa flakes

about.text: Chomchom, cham cham or chum chum is a Bengali sweet made from chhena and garnished with coconut or mawa flakes; the oval brown Porabari variety of Tangail district dates from the mid-19th century.
